description: Runs a web search and returns ranked results as {query, results: [{title, url, snippet}]}. Use it for raw links to read yourself; use research.answer for a written answer. Plain phrases work as well as keywords; since and until (YYYY-MM-DD) limit results to a publish-date range, which suits recent news. Needs an x402 payment per call; if the search fails or finds nothing, you are not charged.

n.description: How many results to return, 1 to 10. Default 5.
n.title: N

q.description: The web search query, 1 to 500 characters.
q.title: Q

since.description: Optional. Only results published on or after this date, written YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-09-01.
since.title: Since

until.description: Optional. Only results published on or before this date, written YYYY-MM-DD.
until.title: Until

name: web.search

published_between.description: The since/until dates applied, if any.
